read_route_guide_database: read the route guide database JSON file and return a list of Feature protobuf objects
create_feature_from_json: create a Feature protobuf object with name and location Point from JSON data
parse_route_guide_db: parse the route_guide_db.json file into a sequence of route_guide_pb2.Feature objects
load_route_guide_features: load all route guide features from the JSON database file into memory
review_read_route_guide_database: review the read_route_guide_database function to understand how it parses JSON into protobuf Features
